summary: nVent Electric plc, through Hoffman Schroff Holdings and nVent Finance S.r.l., completed an $800 million offering of 6.150% senior notes due 2036, guaranteed jointly and severally by the parent and finance subsidiary. Proceeds, alongside a $600 million term loan, a $250 million revolving facility draw and cash, fund the roughly $1.75 billion acquisition of Maverick Power, LLC. The Irish-domiciled registrant acts as acquirer. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or per-share terms appear in the excerpt. Watch closing conditions, leverage and rating-event interest-rate adjustments.
